subject.title: fix(ui): preserve active Workboard sessions when editing cards

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR require live Control UI → Gateway → Workboard store evidence before merge, rather than treating the mocked Chromium scenario as sufficient proof?
rationale: The code path is narrow and the test coverage is useful, but the provided browser scenario replaces the Gateway with a mock and therefore cannot establish the complete user-visible persistence path.

options.title: Request live persistence proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted recording, terminal transcript, or runtime logs that edit an execution-linked card through a live Gateway and show its session link is retained.

options.title: Accept mocked browser coverage
options.body: Merge based on the focused implementation and mocked Chromium coverage while accepting that the plugin-store persistence boundary was not directly demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Request live persistence proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted recording, terminal transcript, or runtime logs that edit an execution-linked card through a live Gateway and show its session link is retained.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the connected reporter and patch author for the Workboard workflow under review.
